title: Interaction stress testing and cross-browser regression log for UI kit
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Run an interaction-focused QA sweep across Safari (iOS/macOS), Firefox (desktop), and key mobile webviews to identify regressions introduced by recent token scale and button density changes. Scope: tokens (spacing, color contrasts), primary/secondary button clickable areas, virtualized table row virtualization + sticky headers, and chart tooltip hit areas when zoomed or scrolled. Deliverables: a prioritized bug list with repro steps, small fix PRs (design tokens or component tweaks), and regression tests (visual + functional) to add to CI. Acceptance criteria: 1) No critical regressions that block basic table/chart workflows on supported browsers; 2) Clear owner and PR for each P0/P1; 3) New flaky cases added to flaky-tests dashboard and triaged for follow-up.
test_matrix: Safari macOS (latest stable) — desktop chrome engine differences: rendering, sticky headers
Safari iOS (latest) — mobile safari: momentum scroll, hit area accuracy
Firefox (latest) — desktop: layering, clip-path, stacking context
Android WebView (Chromium) — representative mobile webview behavior
iOS WKWebView (in-app) — parity with Safari iOS
reproduction_steps: Open the app shell with UI kit v./ui-kit-2026.03 in each target browser/profile.
Load the Charts playground with density=compact and enable tooltips on hover/tap.
Open the Tables demo with virtualized rows, sticky header enabled, and a long-scrolling dataset (1k rows).
On iOS Safari, trigger momentum scroll and attempt row selection during inertial scrolling.
Inspect primary/secondary button tap zones using touch inspector (iOS) and measure hitbox offsets when tokens.scale=0.9.
Run Lighthouse accessibility audit and capture color-contrast failures related to token adjustments.
Record video/GIF of any visual jitter, clipped labels, frozen tooltips, or misaligned sticky headers.
Create a minimal reproduction in a Codesandbox and attach to ticket for each issue found.
observed_issues: ISSUE-120007-A: Chart tooltip remains pinned on Safari iOS after navigation gesture — repro on iPhone 13, appears when density=compact and tooltip close handler fires during scroll.
ISSUE-120007-B: Table sticky header momentarily overlaps first row on Firefox after fast scroll (race with virtualization cleanup) — intermittent, ~1/20 runs.
ISSUE-120007-C: Primary button hitbox reduced by 6-8px on iOS WKWebView when tokens.touch-offset is present — affects small buttons in dense mode.
ISSUE-120007-D: Color token delta (brand-600 -> brand-580) created multiple WCAG AA borderline failures in chart legend contrast on grayscale monitors.
ISSUE-120007-E: Chart pan/zoom gestures cancel tooltip close on Android WebView, leaving persistent tooltip overlay until manual tap outside.
ISSUE-120007-F: Focus outline for table row selection clipped by overflow:hidden container in Safari macOS when density toggled rapidly.
impact_and_priority_notes: ISSUE-120007-A: Medium impact for in-app analytics flows on mobile (can obscure CTA) — mark P1 and create hotfix branch.
ISSUE-120007-B: Causes visual flicker for power users — intermittent; assign for engineering investigation to reproduce reliably (add automated scroll stress test).
ISSUE-120007-C: High impact on touch interactions in compact layouts on iOS webview (affects some enterprise customers) — escalate to P0 if customer report received.
ISSUE-120007-D: Accessibility regression — needs token rollback or contrast tweak; include in accessibility release notes if not fixed before ship.
proposed_fixes: Chart tooltip: debounce the tooltip close handler during touchscroll and add a safety timeout to force close after navigation gestures. (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/ui-kit/pull/1123)

Table sticky header: add a guard in virtualization cleanup to ensure header z-index and translateY are reset after fast scrolls; add e2e scroll stress test. (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/ui-kit/pull/1130)
Primary button hitbox: remove touch-offset application for buttons below 40px in compact mode and add explicit padding token for touch targets. (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/ui-kit/pull/1141)
Color contrast: tweak brand-580 or add a chart-legend-contrast token and run full contrast scan across displays. (Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/DS/Color+Token+Audit)
Focus outline clipping: replace overflow-hidden container with clip-path-aware wrapper or move outline to child element that is not clipped.
test_and_ci_actions: Add flaky scroll stress test to Cypress suite and mark as quarantined for 48 hours while fixes land.
Add visual regression snapshots for compact density charts and table sticky header scenarios across macOS/Safari and Firefox.
Include touch hitbox unit tests that assert minimum clickable area >= 44x44 in compact mode for mobile webviews.
Schedule a chrome/firefox/safari run in BrowserStack nightly with dataset from 'long-scroll' fixtures.
acceptance_criteria: All P0/P1 issues have an associated PR or design decision logged with an owner.
Regression tests added for intermittent behaviors (sticky header, tooltip stickiness) and passing in CI for 3 consecutive runs.
Color contrast fixes verified by a11y lead and included in release notes.
Touch hitbox adjustments validated on device matrix (iPhone 12/13, Android Pixel 6) and via webview smoke tests.
